summary: The TCSP Association recommends that the FCC explicitly exclude bona fide service-provider channel partners and independent sales agents from the definition of consultant when they act on behalf of a service provider in the ordinary course of a commercial relationship and do not act on behalf of the applicant in administering or controlling the E-Rate process. The key distinction is the function performed, not employment classification. The text argues against restricting special construction or dark fiber by citing the importance of competitive bidding processes and the role of independent channel partners in providing valuable services and expertise. The text suggests that excluding legitimate provider-side channel activity from the consultant definition could preserve competition without compromising the applicant's obligation to conduct a fair and open bidding process.
